preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 10**5 and N - 1 <= M <= N * (N - 1) // 2 and 1 <= K <= M for N, M, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive, M is between N-1 and N*(N-1)/2 inclusive, and K is between 1 and M inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A <= N and 1 <= B <= N and A != B and 1 <= C <= 10**9 for N, M, K, roads in test_cases for A, B, C in roads)
preconditions.description: For each road in each test case, A and B are between 1 and N inclusive, A is not equal to B, and C is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output) == 2 and isinstance(output[0], float) and isinstance(output[1], float) for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each output consists of two floating-point numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= output[0] <= roads[K-1][2] for output, roads, K in zip(outputs, test_cases_roads, test_cases_K))
postconditions.description: The first output value is the distance from point P to A on the K-th road, and it is between 0 and the length of the K-th road inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(round(output[0], 5) == output[0] and round(output[1], 5) == output[1] for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: Both output values are rounded to exactly 5 decimal places.

postconditions.expression: all(output[1] == min(max(distances) for distances in possible_distances) for output, possible_distances in zip(outputs, all_possible_distances))
postconditions.description: The second output value is the minimum of the maximum distances from point P to all friends for all possible positions of P on the K-th road.
